fixture: synthetic, artifact-only, no real business data

opportunity.label: Open recommendations — forecast-based estimates of what is at stake

lines.label: Revenue at risk on open recommendations
lines.basis: Forecast demand that current stock would not cover over each open order's protection window, valued at selling price. An estimate of what is at stake.

lines.label: Cost of open recommended orders
lines.basis: Recommended units x unit cost for open purchase recommendations.

estimated_at_approval.label: Estimated when you approved — not observed savings

lines.label: Working capital below the spreadsheet baseline (estimate at approval)
lines.basis: For approved purchase orders: (baseline units - units approved) x the unit cost frozen on the recommendation. Baseline = P90 demand over the full lead-time + review window. It becomes a saving only if the order is placed and received as approved, which Sanket does not record.

lines.label: Carrying cost implied by that difference (derived — not additional)
lines.basis: The working-capital difference x the holding-cost rate, pro-rated over each order's protection window. Derived from the line above; adding the two double-counts.

lines.label: Revenue at risk covered by approved orders (estimate)
lines.basis: Forecast demand stock on hand would not have covered, valued at selling price, for each approved order. Revenue, not profit, and not observed sales.

lines.label: Approved orders on SKUs with an open shortage alert
lines.basis: Approved purchase orders whose SKU had an open or acknowledged shortage alert when the recommendation was generated. A count of approvals, not of stockouts avoided: whether a stockout was avoided is not observed.

lines.label: Realised savings
lines.basis: Not measurable yet. Sanket records approvals, but no supplier order, goods receipt or post-order sell-through, so no saving or avoided stockout has been observed. Measuring it needs those records, compared against the baseline for the same weeks.

report.caveat: Estimates use the inputs frozen on each recommendation. Approving a recommendation is a decision, not an outcome: none of these figures is money saved until orders, receipts and sales confirm it.
